executiveSummary.headline: Protect a Strong Luxury Position With One Coherent, Accurate Story
executiveSummary.lead: Castillo Hotel Son Vida records 50.0% consideration and 62.1% scenario presence, ranking first among four Bonvoy peers. The measured position is credible but not universal. Management’s highest-value work is to resolve the spa-size conflict and make the adults-only Luxury Collection castle, Arabella golf, wellness, events, and wedding offer read as one precise luxury proposition.

themes.title: The Spa Measurement Requires Hotel Confirmation
themes.what: The same Marriott overview describes the spa as both 900 and 990 square metres, apparently referring to the same facility.
themes.whyItMatters: The conflict is verified, but the correct figure is not. Spa operations must confirm scope and measurement before Marriott corrects the page; the audit should not invent a winner.

themes.title: Distinctive Luxury Attributes Need One Narrative
themes.what: Official content combines an adults-only Luxury Collection castle, Arabella golf access, wellness, meetings, and weddings.
themes.whyItMatters: A signed fact architecture can connect these strengths while distinguishing on-property, affiliated, seasonal, and policy-dependent elements—giving leisure guests and international planners a coherent luxury offer without overstating access or ownership.

themes.title: Narrow Signals Deserve Proportionate Review
themes.what: A Marriott access probe returned an Akamai 403 pattern, and Hotel Saratoga displaced Castillo in only three monitored scenarios.
themes.whyItMatters: Neither observation establishes a broad weakness. Platform support should investigate access, while commercial leadership can review the three scenarios lightly and close them if they are not strategically relevant.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The spa has one hotel-approved measurement or clearly labeled scopes, the luxury proposition is consistent across official pages, and narrow technical and competitive reviews have documented outcomes.
executiveSummary.closing: Castillo Hotel Son Vida can strengthen a credible measured position through precision, not volume: resolve the 900/990 m² spa discrepancy, connect the adults-only castle, golf, wellness, and events offer, and keep the three Hotel Saratoga scenarios in proportion. Digital authority: Visit Palma destination inventories already list Castillo Hotel Son Vida alongside Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf—strong destination authority for luxury and meetings demand. Digital content readiness: Castillo’s Marriott Luxury Collection brand page and Visit Palma destination listing already provide strong discovery surfaces.
